g.text: EXTERNAL ESP32 BUTTON BRIDGE - PROPOSED MODIFICATION

g.desc: EXTERNAL ESP32 BUTTON BRIDGE - PROPOSED MODIFICATION

g.text: Net names alone do not establish function.

g.desc: Net names alone do not establish function.

g.text: DNP = not fitted; unknown routes are not NCs.

g.desc: DNP = not fitted; unknown routes are not NCs.

g.text: D1 identity and timing function remain unverified.

g.desc: D1 identity and timing function remain unverified.

g.text: U2: 6.3 V measured; C14R candidate rated only to 5.5 V.

g.desc: U2: 6.3 V measured; C14R candidate rated only to 5.5 V.

g.text: Symbol and ERC conflict retained intentionally.

g.desc: Symbol and ERC conflict retained intentionally.

g.text: USB power only; share GND, keep positive supplies separate.

g.desc: USB power only; share GND, keep positive supplies separate.

g.text: HIGH = brief press; LOW = release. Initial pulse ~200 ms (unverified timing).

g.desc: HIGH = brief press; LOW = release. Initial pulse ~200 ms (unverified timing).

g.text: Boot / reset must release. Never hold HIGH to keep unlocked.

g.desc: Boot / reset must release. Never hold HIGH to keep unlocked.

g.text: Mode toggle only: no OPEN/CLOSE command or latch feedback.

g.desc: Mode toggle only: no OPEN/CLOSE command or latch feedback.

g.text: Confirm owned TO-92 lead order and board startup before assembly.

g.desc: Confirm owned TO-92 lead order and board startup before assembly.

g.text: USB powers U201 internally; 5V/3V3 header pins are deliberately unused.

g.desc: USB powers U201 internally; 5V/3V3 header pins are deliberately unused.

g.text: C42 / R47 / R46 are unpopulated options.

g.desc: C42 / R47 / R46 are unpopulated options.

g.text: Receiver gain, bias behavior and Q7 switching remain unverified.

g.desc: Receiver gain, bias behavior and Q7 switching remain unverified.

g.text: Q3 diode readings dispute the PNP pinout.

g.desc: Q3 diode readings dispute the PNP pinout.

g.text: U6: S-812C33 candidate; PIR supply measured 3.3 V.

g.desc: U6: S-812C33 candidate; PIR supply measured 3.3 V.

g.text: D2: measured series equivalent; identity unverified.

g.desc: D2: measured series equivalent; identity unverified.

g.text: ANT1 / ANT2: solder pads; L101 is the external coil.

g.desc: ANT1 / ANT2: solder pads; L101 is the external coil.

g.text: Main board, external antenna and proposed bridge.

g.desc: Main board, external antenna and proposed bridge.

g.text: PIR internals, motor and firmware are outside scope.

g.desc: PIR internals, motor and firmware are outside scope.

g.text: Candidate U1 pin 4 is internally open;

g.desc: Candidate U1 pin 4 is internally open;
